description: Creates a filter object, based on filter options, to notify when the state changes (logs). To check if the state has changed, call eth_getFilterChanges.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The transaction response object which contains the following filter information:

sub_parameters.name: fromBlock
sub_parameters.description: The block number as a string in hexadecimal format or tags. The supported tag values include earliest for the earliest/genesis block, latest for the latest mined block, pending for the pending state/transactions, safe for the most recent secure block, and finalized for the most recent secure block accepted by more than 2/3 of validators. safe and finalized are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova, and Avalanche C-chain

sub_parameters.name: toBlock
sub_parameters.description: The block number as a string in hexadecimal format or tags. The supported tag values include earliest for the earliest/genesis block, latest for the latest mined block, pending for the pending state/transactions, safe for the most recent secure block, and finalized for the most recent secure block accepted by more than 2/3 of validators. safe and finalized are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova, and Avalanche C-chain

sub_parameters.name: address
sub_parameters.description: The contract address or a list of addresses from which logs should originate

sub_parameters.name: topics
sub_parameters.description: An array of DATA topics and also, the topics are order-dependent. Visit here to learn more about topics

result.description: It returns a filter id to be used when calling eth_getFilterChanges
